chapters.title: Plain recursion

frames.caption: Plain recursion — O(2m+n) time, O(m + n) extra space. Input: calculate_minimum_hp(dungeon=[[2, -8], [-1, 5]]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
def need(r, c): (least health on entering (r, c))
if r == m or c == n: → false (c = 0, m = 2, n = 2, r = 0)
if r == m - 1 and c == n - 1: → false (c = 0, m = 2, n = 2, r = 0)
return max(1, min(need(r + 1, c), need(r, c + 1)) - dungeon[r][c]) — calls need(r=1, c=0)
if r == m or c == n: → false (c = 0, m = 2, n = 2, r = 1)
if r == m - 1 and c == n - 1: → false (c = 0, m = 2, n = 2, r = 1)
return max(1, min(need(r + 1, c), need(r, c + 1)) - dungeon[r][c]) — calls need(r=2, c=0)
if r == m or c == n: → true (c = 0, m = 2, n = 2, r = 2)
if r == m or c == n: → false (c = 1, m = 2, n = 2, r = 1) — r = 1; c = 1
if r == m - 1 and c == n - 1: → true (c = 1, m = 2, n = 2, r = 1)
if r == m or c == n: → false (c = 1, m = 2, n = 2, r = 0) — r = 0
if r == m - 1 and c == n - 1: → false (c = 1, m = 2, n = 2, r = 0)
return max(1, min(need(r + 1, c), need(r, c + 1)) - dungeon[r][c]) — calls need(r=1, c=1)
if r == m or c == n: → false (c = 1, m = 2, n = 2, r = 1)
if r == m - 1 and c == n - 1: → true (c = 1, m = 2, n = 2, r = 1)
if r == m or c == n: → true (c = 2, m = 2, n = 2, r = 0) — r = 0; c = 2
